claim: RackAnalogChorus DSP is KIS ChorusCE1::Stereo (AnalogChorus::ProcessBuffer calls it)
CE-1 delay comes from a 9-point voltage-to-time table, 1.138 ms (V<=0) to 2.943 ms (V>=15), x0=-7.5 step 3.75
CE-1 chorus mode: triangle LFO, rate 1+2*ChorusInt Hz, control 4.469 +- 6.598 V; vibrato: sine 3.4..12.5 Hz, depth (2.5R+11(1-R))*D*0.5998, base 4.469*D
CE-1 Stereo out0 = 100% wet (mix field initialised to 1.0, never set); out1 = dry unless StereoMode
All chorus delay lines use 2-tap linear interpolation (AT2 DelayLineVariable, CE1 Module, MXR)
AT2 chorus graph: Lfo -> LfoRescaler(Offset 0..50 def 12, Scale 0..8 def 1) -> DelayLine(58 ms max) ; MixerOut = A1*wet + A2*dry, defaults 0.5/0.5, no feedback
AT2 ChorusStereo = two Chorus voices with RelativePhase default 0.5 (antiphase LFOs)
MXR rate = 0.1 + 9.9*r^6 Hz; delay lo=0.55ms*(4.5+2.75*sqrt(w)*4^r), hi=0.55ms*(4.5+(23-10r)*sqrt(w)); LFO = 0.5+0.5 sin table
MXR wet path has a first-order 200 Hz shelf (+30*Bass dB at DC) and a Q=0.3 bell at min(6500 Hz,0.45fs) (+24*Treble dB); wet gain 0.13+0.385*sqrt(Intensity)
Fender Triangle Chorus UI maps Rate 0.08..10 -> 0.18..10 Hz, Depth -> 0..3 ms, Bias -> 8..25 ms, RelativePhase -> 0..0.5
